defects.noop_load: runner.load(load_cfg={'actor': True}) on a -Distill* task loads nothing (rsl_rl Distillation.load ignores the key): the numbers are a randomly initialised student.  Fixed in d94d944 (piper_push.evalcfg.load_weights).
defects.no_gru_reset: eval_endurance/eval_occlusion did not reset the GRU hidden state on episode boundaries before 2026-09-04 01:26; a recurrent student carried the last episode's state into the next.  Fixed in 4cf9800 (reset_recurrent).
defects.clean_sensor: measured with the depth noise and mask jitter off (the play-mode default on a nominal task).  A student distilled under the fitted sensor collapses under a clean one (results/audit_20260904: 4/min -> 0.2 vs ~32/min with the sensor on), so this is out-of-distribution, not a baseline.  Default changed to --sensor measured on 2026-09-04.
